text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having claimed victory, Eishin Flash feels 
the eyes of her predecessors upon her as 
she builds confidence heading into the 
Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as she felt she could fulfill the 
rest of her schedule— a call came from her 
parents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They were coming to Japan to watch her 
race. Overjoyed by the news, she swore to 
claim victory in every race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With their ultimate target set on the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn), where both of them 
will meet— anticipation mounts for the 
Osaka Hai leading up to it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, with so many legends 
who had defined an era entering GⅠ races, 
the Trainer couldn't shake an ominous 
feeling—
